clue.text: Business house has in this case to remain united

parts.note: a business house is a company, abbreviated CO
in this case or instance means here

explanation.surface: A firm decides that, in this situation, it must stay together.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohere is to stick together as a consistent whole.

clue.text: Order to start shooting in military engagement

explanation.surface: A command to open fire in battle.
explanation.definitionFit: A film director calls this word to begin a take, and a battle is also called this.

clue.text: Describe one way to make the customer pay up

definitions.text: one way to make the customer pay up

explanation.surface: An explanation of how to get a client to settle the bill.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a report of events, and also to send a client a bill for payment.

clue.text: Case of equipment which should be clutched

definitions.text: Case of equipment which should be clutched

parts.words: Case of equipment which should be clutched
parts.note: a box holding equipment that you grip tightly; in a car, the clutch pedal is pressed before shifting the cogs in this housing

explanation.surface: A box of kit that you should hold on to tightly.
explanation.definitionFit: The transmission housing in a car is operated with the clutch pedal before each change of gear ratio.

clue.text: What the motoring honeymooner needs!

parts.note: a driver would need a permit, and a newly-wed needs official permission to wed: the clue jokes about a permit for the wedding car

explanation.surface: A joke about the paperwork a newly-wed driver must carry.
explanation.definitionFit: The official permit to wed, punned on a driving permit for the motoring newly-wed.

clue.text: Agreed that fellow member hadn't told the truth

parts.note: co- as in co-worker means a fellow
MP is a Member of Parliament
someone who hadn't told the truth lied

explanation.surface: A parliamentarian was found to have been dishonest after he agreed.
explanation.definitionFit: To have complied is to have gone along with a request or rule.

clue.text: Virginia and Leonard pursued by American intelligence in Spain

definitions.note: the definition stands for a place found in Spain

indicators.note: pursued by means the next piece comes behind the earlier ones

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
Len is short for Leonard
the CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency

explanation.surface: Two people named Virginia and Leonard are trailed by US spies.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish port city on the Mediterranean coast, home of paella.

clue.text: Specific advice on studying centre of Minoan culture

parts.note: con is an old verb meaning to study, so the imperative 'con!' is advice to study
the Minoan civilisation was centred on the Greek island of Crete

explanation.surface: Precise guidance on researching the heartland of an ancient Bronze Age civilisation.
explanation.definitionFit: Concrete means definite and particular rather than abstract.

clue.text: Lacking principles, so in need of a lesson

parts.note: the moral of a story is its lesson

explanation.surface: Someone without scruples clearly needs to be taught something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so in need of' links: an unprincipled person is in need of a moral.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone amoral has no sense of right and wrong at all.

clue.text: Song which generates atmosphere

explanation.surface: A tune that creates a mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A melody or tune, and also the gas mixture we breathe around us.

clue.text: Cause confusion by urging greater violence

explanation.surface: Someone sows chaos by encouraging people to get rougher.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as 'be wilder', the word urges someone to grow wilder.
explanation.definitionFit: To bewilder is to perplex; split in two, it is an exhortation to grow more savage.

clue.text: Artillerymen take landing-ground by the sword

definitions.note: the definition is the bare noun, 'by the' being linking words

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the British army's gunners
a pier is a landing stage where boats tie up

explanation.surface: Gunners capture a landing place at swordpoint.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapier is a slender, sharp-pointed thrusting blade.

clue.text: Painter who varied an old icon to order

indicators.note: made to order means arranged as required, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An artist who altered an antique religious picture on commission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'varied' looks like the anagram signal, but it is fodder; 'to order' rearranges VARIEDANOLDICON.
explanation.definitionFit: The Renaissance artist who created the Mona Lisa and The Last Supper.

clue.text: Sound alternative to sail

indicators.note: sound signals a word that is heard rather than written

parts.note: or is the word offering an alternative

explanation.surface: A good option for propelling a boat instead of canvas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' is the homophone signal, though it reads as 'reliable'; the whole clue also defines a rowing blade as a substitute for a sail.
explanation.definitionFit: Rowing with a blade is the other way to move a boat without wind.

clue.text: Plant producing a range of automobiles

parts.note: a car is an automobile
a product line is a range of goods

explanation.surface: A factory turning out a series of cars.
explanation.definitionFit: The carline thistle is a spiny wild flower of dry grassland.

clue.text: Maybe the product of an irrigated paddy-field doesn't come cheap

parts.note: an gives the indefinite article A
watered from a tap, so tap fits the idea of irrigation
rice is the crop of a paddy field

explanation.surface: Rice from a well-watered paddy is expensive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maybe the product of' links: the crop grown with tap water might be called 'a tap rice'.
explanation.definitionFit: Available at a price means obtainable only at significant cost.

clue.text: Anatomical features on which turbulent nags rely

indicators.note: turbulent means disorderly, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Body parts that unruly horses depend upon.
explanation.definitionFit: The plural of the voice box in the throat.

clue.text: Why Wendy was in mourning and straight-faced?

explanation.surface: A question about why a girl was grieving and showing no emotion.
explanation.walkthrough: Wendy is the heroine of Peter Pan; she would mourn if Pan were dead.
explanation.definitionFit: Expressionless and impassive, often while joking; the first reading has the boy who never grew up deceased.

clue.text: Additional note I add to a letter

parts.note: PS (postscript) is a note added to a letter

explanation.surface: A postscript added at the end of correspondence.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek alphabet's twenty-third character.

clue.text: Searching enquiry by the coroner

explanation.surface: A thorough investigation held by an official into a death.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as 'in quest', it means searching.
explanation.definitionFit: A judicial investigation into a death, and also, split, a phrase meaning on the hunt.

clue.text: Persuade people to support sentence in the courts

definitions.text: people to support sentence in the courts

explanation.surface: Convincing the public to back a court's ruling.
explanation.definitionFit: To be convincing; also literally to bear a criminal's guilty verdict.

clue.text: Two seamen of Mongol descent

indicators.note: two means the piece is written twice in a row

parts.note: a tar is a sailor; the plural covers the two copies

explanation.surface: A pair of sailors with ancestry from the Asian steppes.
explanation.definitionFit: Tartars were Turkic and Mongol peoples of the Golden Horde.

clue.text: Frankly, it's just about games lessons

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around another here

parts.note: just means only
PE (physical education) is school games lessons

explanation.surface: Honestly, it's really all about sport at school.
explanation.definitionFit: Done openly means done without concealment, candidly.

clue.text: Gallic leader of the Falangists

explanation.surface: A French head of a Spanish fascist movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Franco- is the prefix meaning French; General Franco led the Spanish Falange party.

clue.text: Endure an upheaval which is not deserved

indicators.note: an upheaval is a violent disturbance, so these letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: Suffering a disruption that was undeserved.
explanation.definitionFit: Unearned means gained without merit or effort.

clue.text: Take advantage of American cardinal

parts.note: US means American
E (east) is one of the four cardinal compass points

explanation.surface: Exploiting a senior US churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: To use someone is to exploit them selfishly.

clue.text: Film Red Indian tribe in Senegal

indicators.note: in means one piece is placed within another here

parts.note: SN is the international code for Senegal
the Cree are a Native American people

explanation.surface: Shooting a movie about a Native American people in West Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: To screen something is to show or record it as a movie.

clue.text: Thus in a cable I can be quite friendly

parts.note: so means thus

indicators.note: in means a piece is set inside the other here

explanation.surface: So a telegram can say you are being rather warm.
explanation.definitionFit: Sociable means fond of company and outgoing.
